name: Sunkissed Froleek
description: Froleek enjoy cavorting throughout the Chiseled Caverns, from dancing in Moonglow Grotto to sunbathing in Sunken Sunvault.

name: Fresh Howlug
description: Green as the Verdant Veins, this Howlug gets its hue from eating ten times its weight in cave kelp daily! An insatiable appetite for an incorrigible scamp.

name: Ember Cragglepod
description: A cragglepod commonly found in the depths of Sunken Sunvault. While often skittish in the wild, they warm up quickly to those it trusts.

name: Curious Gleemur
description: Blink and you might miss the Gleemur, who easily blend into their verdant environments. A coolheaded creature, always up for a challenge.

name: Bouncy Hoppet
description: With its highly social personality, Hoppet were the first cave creatures domesticated by Geodians. It loves being around others, especially when sweets are on offer.

name: Amber Jelotl
description: This common jelotl is happy to meander anywhere, watering its environments as it jaunts from flower to flower, plant to plant.

name: Quizzical Qubrik
description: Ancient cave paintings suggest that these mysterious and mercurial creatures have been observing boulder and pebble life from afar for centuries.

name: Zigzag Zepperay
description: Given the Zepperay's shyness, watching this creature run away may be all that strangers experience of it - yet how fortunate we are that its speed itself is a wonder!

name: Growing Heckbug
description: Babies are always cute, but this one might be an exception.

name: Angler Heckbug-Hybrid
description: It's hard to tell why it lights the way since it has no eyes.

name: Dragonfly Heckbug
description: Dragonflys are mystical, but this one still scares me.

name: Wistful Froleek
description: Unlike its brethren, this pensive Froleek enjoys solitude and quiet. It can often be found daydreaming alone in  peaceful pools of cave milk.

name: Glamorous Howlug
description: With its robust coloring and spellbinding eyes, this Howlug is a beauty, only sparing a glance for the most vivacious of courtship dances.

name: Roseflame Cragglepod
description: This cragglepod's rosy hue and sweet disposition comes from its diet of sugary sun sap! The light on its head burns more gently than others.

name: Impish Gleemur
description: Study of this playful Gleemur has proven difficult due to its frequent theft of Sunseeker notes. Unapologetic pranksters, the lot of them.

name: Handsome Hoppet
description: Because of this Hoppet's love of cave milk baths, its skin is flawless - and it knows it! - always happy to gaze at its own reflection or bat its silken eyelashes at passersby.

name: Waverider Jelotl
description: Always drenched, this uncommon jelotl makes a splash wherever it goes! It is an affectionate pet when tamed, so do your shoes a favor and go barefoot.

name: Delicate Qubrik
description: These emotional Qubrik hold onto embarrassment so tightly, their bodies turn pink forever - or at least longer than most Geodian life spans!

name: Lithe Zepperay
description: Pink from its waggling tongue to its twitching tail, this Zepperay streaks across the skies as naturally as blush across a waking dawn.

name: Zippin' Heckbug
description: Wings? They fly? This keeps getting worse!

name: Heckbug-Hybrid Hopper
description: There's a lot of evidence that this thing can hop great distances, but no one has ever seen it actually hop.

name: Cragged Heckbug
description: Four legs means four times the speed, right?

name: Jubilant Froleek
description: Vibrant leaves set this dazzling Froleek apart from others. It never tires of expressing its joy, whether its getting treats, pets, or even a little bit of attention.

name: Supersonic Howlug
description: This Howlug, with its singular racing stripe, loves to slime circles around its kind. Though it's not actually any faster, it is no doubt a legend in its own mind.

name: Viridian Cragglepod
description: This vibrant cragglepod is known for its bold personality and impenetrable shell. It can be social - even garrulous - with those it considers friends.

name: Shrouded Gleemur
description: Sightings of this Gleemur only began after the Shadow's infiltration. It survived by disguising itself to fit its sundered environs.

name: Effervescent Hoppet
description: Bright-eyed and bouncy, this Hoppet is irrepressible even in the face of Shadows. It is oblivious to danger, too innocent to fathom being harmed.

name: Spectral Jelotl
description: When the Shadows came, many jelotl habitats were destroyed. This jelotl survived by masking itself in chaotic energy - a bright spot in a dark time.

name: Enigmatic Qubrik
description: When looking upon this Qubrik, one thinks of the Geodian poet, Breccia Schist, who wrote, 'In this strange mirror, we see all of the world.'

name: Majestic Zepperay
description: How lightly its wings flutter! It is a pleasure to watch this Zepperay drift through Moonglow Grotto, as lilting and winsome as Geodian song.

name: Abhorrent Heckbug
description: If this is what Geode does to heckbugs, let's just hope they never make it to the surface.

name: Four Faced Heckbug-Hybrid
description: It's hard to tell if this is one heckbug or many banded together. Either way it's disturbing.

name: Hoppin' Heckbug
description: The heckbugs that can't fly still find a way.
